name: Proactive Insurance Policy Guardian
description: An AI assistant that makes insurance policy PDFs easier to understand through natural-language questions. Flask parses documents with PyPDF2, SentenceTransformers embeds text passages, and FAISS retrieves relevant context for answer generation through the Hugging Face Inference API. Built for the DSW Hackathon Challenge as an educational project.

name: The HangMan Game
description: Interactive Pygame application teaching DBMS concepts through gameplay, with a SQLite-backed dynamic question bank and randomized logic for replayability.

name: KrushiPal
description: Full-stack e-commerce platform connecting farmers directly with consumers, eliminating middlemen. Responsive React frontend with RESTful APIs (Node.js/Express), role-based dashboards with secure auth, and optimized MongoDB aggregation pipelines for fast search and orders.

name: CultivateConnect
description: ML system forecasting crop yields with 91% prediction accuracy, serving real-time predictions in production behind Flask REST APIs. Interactive Chart.js dashboards backed by MongoDB for visualization and trend analysis.

name: ARNav
description: Marker-based indoor navigation app enabling real-time wayfinding without GPS, using Flutter, Unity3D, and ARCore. Integrated Visual SLAM with REST APIs for live position tracking and directional overlays, backed by Firebase services for indoor maps and POIs.
